headline: השכפול ל-DR למטה — לטפל מיד
source: powermax, powerflex, mds and ucs-central MCP (read-only), vCenter alarms via Aria
summary: תקלה אמיתית אחת: קבוצת SRDF 10 ל-DC2 למטה מאז 02:14. שתי התראות נובעות מאותה סיבה - SFP תקול ב-MDS-A fc1/5.
actions: Open a case with the WAN team: DC1→DC2 RDF links down since 02:14 (both RDF ports online, no remote partner)
Replace the SFP in MDS-A fc1/5, then rescan ESX-12 to bring path vmhba2:C0:T3 back
Replace drive SDS-03 slot 7 (rebuild already complete)

alerts.title: קבוצת SRDF 10 - כל הקישורים למטה
alerts.message: RDF group 10 (0x0A): all RDF links are offline. Remote Symmetrix 000197900456 not reachable.
alerts.why: השכפול ל-DR מושבת 5 שעות - ה-RPO כבר נחצה.
alerts.what: כל קישורי SRDF בקבוצה 10 למטה; כתיבות ב-DC1 לא מועתקות ל-DC2.
alerts.impact: 42 production devices (SG prod_oracle) have no DR copy since 02:14.
alerts.cause: The inter-site path, not the array: both RDF directors are up but see no remote partner.
evidence: RDF ports 1E:4 and 2E:4 online, link state Offline, 0 remote ports seen
No RDF port, director or array alert on either side
Both ports went down within 6 s of each other at 02:14 - points to a shared WAN / DWDM path
steps: Ask the WAN team to check the DC1→DC2 DWDM / IP path used by the RDF ports at 02:14
When the links are up, resume the pairs
Watch invalid tracks drain to 0 before closing the incident
commands: symrdf -sid 123 -rdfg 10 -sg prod_oracle resume   # after links are up
alerts.verify: symrdf query shows pair state Synchronized and invalid tracks 0.

sources.title: PowerMax Events and Alerts Guide - event 1220 (PowerMaxOS 10)

alerts.title: ESX-12 lost one path to datastore DS-PROD-07
alerts.message: Path redundancy to storage device naa.600009700001979001235330 30304531 degraded. Path vmhba2:C0:T3:L12 is down. 1 remaining active paths.
alerts.why: The datastore runs on one path - one more failure takes 14 VMs down.
alerts.what: ESX-12 has one of its two paths to DS-PROD-07 down; it still works on fabric B.
alerts.impact: No outage now, but no redundancy for 14 VMs.
alerts.cause: Same root cause as the CRC alert below: the SFP on MDS-A fc1/5 (ESX-12 vmhba2) is failing.
evidence: vmhba2 WWPN 21:00:00:24:ff:4c:12:a2 logs in on MDS-A fc1/5
Path went dead 3 min after CRC errors started climbing
steps: Fix the SFP on MDS-A fc1/5 (next alert)
Rescan vmhba2 on ESX-12 and check both paths are Active
commands: esxcli storage core path list -d naa.60000970000197900123533030304531
alerts.verify: 2 paths Active (I/O) for the device; vCenter alarm clears.
alerts.related: Caused by: CRC errors on MDS-A fc1/5

alerts.title: CRC errors on MDS-A fc1/5
alerts.message: %PORT-5-IF_DOWN_LINK_FAILURE: %$VSAN 10%$ Interface fc1/5 is down (Link failure loss of signal)
alerts.why: It already cost ESX-12 a path; it will keep flapping until the optic is replaced.
alerts.what: Frames arrive damaged on this port and the link drops.
alerts.cause: A failing SFP: receive power is below the alarm threshold.
evidence: 118 CRC errors in 9 h, 0 before Sun 22:37
Transceiver RX power -11.8 dBm, low alarm -11.0 dBm
Peer HBA reports no errors on its side
steps: Replace the SFP in fc1/5 (same type: 32G SW)
If errors continue: replace the cable
commands: show interface fc1/5 counters | i crc
alerts.verify: RX power above -9 dBm and CRC counter stays at 0 for 1 hour.

alerts.title: PowerFlex drive failed - rebuild finished
alerts.message: Device /dev/sdh on SDS SDS-03 failed. Rebuild started for 1.8 TB.
alerts.why: Data is fully protected again; the pool has one fewer drive of spare capacity.
alerts.what: One SSD failed; PowerFlex rebuilt its data onto the other drives.
steps: Replace the drive in SDS-03 slot 7
Add the new device to sp-ssd and let it rebalance
alerts.verify: New device Normal, spare capacity back to ≥10%.
